title.zh: 腾讯WorkBuddy被指抄袭Claude Code：224段文本相同，连内部代号都出现了
title.en: 腾讯WorkBuddy被指抄袭Claude Code：224段文本相同，连内部代号都出现了

current_state.zh: A technical report alleges Tencent's WorkBuddy desktop client reused 224 identical text segments and internal `tengu_` codenames from Claude Code's leaked source code, prompting plagiarism accusations that Tencent partially attributes to plugin-spec compatibility.
